:::{#def-folds}
#### Folds

A division of observations $1, \ldots, n$ into $k$ **folds**
is a partition of $\set{1, \ldots, n}$ into $k$ nonempty, disjoint subsets
$\fold{1}, \ldots, \fold{k}$:

$$
\fold{1} \cup \cdots \cup \fold{k} = \set{1, \ldots, n}.
$$ {#eq-folds}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@james2021islr2e [sec. 5.1.3] and @hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1],
who split the data into $k$ roughly equal-sized parts.
:::

:::
